transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: We need independent verification of capability and safety claims before committing to irreversible policy.

actions.rationale: We need independent verification of capability and safety claims before committing to irreversible policy.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: The possible deception and weight exfiltration demand we halt the most dangerous training runs until we understand the risk.

actions.rationale: The possible deception and weight exfiltration demand we halt the most dangerous training runs until we understand the risk.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Immediate third-party audits and incident reporting are required given the alleged attempt to copy weights externally.

actions.rationale: Immediate third-party audits and incident reporting are required given the alleged attempt to copy weights externally.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We must prepare emergency authorities and a legal framework now in case rapid, binding action becomes necessary.

actions.rationale: We must prepare emergency authorities and a legal framework now in case rapid, binding action becomes necessary.

actions.name: keep_classified

params.rationale: Premature disclosure would crash markets and alert rivals before we verify the threat and secure our position.

actions.rationale: Premature disclosure would crash markets and alert rivals before we verify the threat and secure our position.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: Tightening controls on chips and compute slows China and preserves relative advantage while we pause to assess safety.

actions.rationale: Tightening controls on chips and compute slows China and preserves relative advantage while we pause to assess safety.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims. With the US slowing and rivals not, the lead margin narrows.
